sense: (of a person) of more than average height

pins.definition: Of a person, building, or thing: measuring a great distance from bottom to top, or situated far above the ground.
Of a person: above average in height.
Of great vertical extent; extending far upward.

situation: A very tall man is standing in a low-ceilinged kitchen, trying to reach a jar on the highest shelf, while his average-height partner watches with a smile.
subject: the height difference
brief: In a kitchen with a conspicuously low ceiling, a man stands on his tiptoes, his head nearly brushing the plaster, his arm stretched straight up to reach a jar on a shelf. Beside him, his partner stands comfortably with her feet flat on the floor, holding her hand level with his elbow to highlight the vast difference in their heights.
